privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Asanova (Android package com.asanova.yoga, also on iPhone and iPad) is a guided yoga, breathwork and meditation app. This policy explains what information the app handles, why, who receives it and the choices you have. Your answers, body details and practice history stay on your phone; we never send your health answers to anyone. We use PostHog for usage statistics and Meta (Facebook) for advertising measurement, and you can switch both off. Payments are handled by Apple or Google, or an approved payment service when an India UPI option is available. We do not sell your personal information.

p: Asanova is developed and published by Prana Codes ("we", "us"). Contact person and privacy/grievance contact: Mohit. Email: pranacodes@gmail.com. Mobile: +91 90347 05852. Business address: Prana Codes, 164, Barauli (24), Baroli, Sonipat, Haryana 131021, India. We are the controller of the personal information described here; these contacts also receive requests and grievances under applicable Indian data-protection law.
Asanova does not have user accounts. You do not need to give us your name, email address or phone number to use it.

sections.h: 2. Information that stays on your device
p: Your onboarding answers (such as age range, gender, goals, height and weight, activity level, flexibility, balance, experience, areas of the body you want to protect and any physical limitations), your first name if you enter one, your plan, practice history, feelings you log after a session, favourites, downloads, reminders and settings are stored only on your phone or tablet.

We treat answers about pain, injuries, physical limitations and body measurements as health information. They are used on your device to shape your plan and are never sent to us, our analytics provider, Meta or any other company.
You can erase this information at any time in Profile → Reset all data, or by uninstalling the app.

We use PostHog (PostHog Inc., United States) to understand which parts of Asanova help people and where they get stuck. The app sends screen views and named app events, for example: the app was opened and how long it took to start; which onboarding steps were viewed or completed and non-health choices such as goals, experience or preferred session length; paywall views, plan selections, purchases and restores; courses, lessons, meditations and breathing sessions started, finished or left early; lesson download results and times; ratings you give in the app; and settings you change.

These events carry a random identifier created by the app, your app version, language, device type, operating system and approximate country derived from your IP address. They never include your health answers, body measurements, name, email, the text of your feedback or your precise location. There is no session recording, no screen capture and no tracking of what you type.

Asanova shows no ads inside the app. We do advertise Asanova on Facebook and Instagram, and we use the Meta app-events SDK and Meta's Conversions API (Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. and Meta Platforms, Inc.) to measure whether those ads lead to installs and subscriptions, and to show our ads to people more likely to find the app useful.

When this is switched on, Meta receives: that the app was installed and opened; that onboarding was completed; that the plans screen was viewed or a purchase was started; and, through RevenueCat, that a free trial started or a subscription was bought (with its product, price and currency). Together with these events Meta receives device information (such as device model, operating system, app version, language, time zone and IP address), an anonymous app identifier created by the Meta SDK, a scrambled (hashed) version of our anonymous purchase identifier and, where your device allows it, your device's advertising identifier.

We never send Meta your health answers, body measurements, name, email, practice details, meditation or course content, or feedback. Meta processes this information under its own terms and data policy (facebook.com/privacy/policy) and may combine it with information it already holds about you, for example to attribute an install to an ad you saw.

On iPhone and iPad, the app asks your permission (App Tracking Transparency) before your advertising identifier can be used; if you choose Ask App Not to Track, the advertising identifier is not collected and Meta receives only limited, non-tracking measurement. On Android you can reset or delete your advertising identifier in your device settings (Settings → Privacy → Ads, or Google → Ads).

Profile → Privacy → Usage statistics switches off both PostHog usage statistics and Meta advertising measurement from the app. The choice is stored on your phone and applies immediately. Purchases made after you switch it off are not reported to Meta.

You can also limit tracking in your device settings (iOS: Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking; Android: delete or reset your advertising ID), reset all app data in Profile, or uninstall the app. Meta also offers ad preference controls in your Facebook and Instagram settings.
Payments are processed by the Apple App Store or Google Play under their own terms. We never see or store your card or payment details.

India — UPI payments, when enabled: an approved payment service processes the payment and any recurring mandate. The available offer, exact INR amount, billing frequency and renewal terms are shown before payment. The current proposed offer is ₹2 for the first day, then ₹399 per month; it is not available until the payment service is approved and activated. Your UPI PIN is entered only in your UPI app; Asanova never asks for, receives or stores it. Your payment app, payment processor, payment network and bank handle payment credentials under their own policies.

For enabled UPI subscriptions our servers (Lovable Cloud) may store a hashed random app-installation identifier used for access, our transaction number, amount and currency, verified payment status, bank reference (UTR), mandate reference, paid-until date and necessary payment confirmations from the processor. A private installation key stays on your phone and is sent only over encrypted connections to verify payment-status requests; it is never used for analytics or advertising. Older test versions used Android ID; those versions cannot prove ownership of production payments. Payment confirmations may contain limited additional payment metadata supplied by the processor. Access is restricted and records are used for service delivery, fraud prevention, refunds and reconciliation, not advertising. Records are retained only as necessary for the subscription and applicable legal, tax and accounting obligations, generally up to 8 years where required. We do not collect your phone number or email in the Asanova payment screen; any information required by a processor is disclosed on its approval screen.

We use RevenueCat (RevenueCat, Inc., United States) to check whether you have Asanova Plus and to restore purchases. RevenueCat receives an anonymous app user identifier, your store purchase receipts (product, price, currency, dates, renewal and trial status, country), your device type, app version, the anonymous PostHog and Meta app identifiers and, where your device allows it, your advertising identifier, so that a trial or subscription can be counted correctly in our statistics and advertising measurement.

When you use Tell us what you need, we store your message, an optional reply email, the submission time, app version and platform in a private inbox hosted by Lovable Cloud. Other app users cannot read these messages. No onboarding answers, practice history, purchase identifier or advertising identifier is attached. Please do not include health or payment details.
We use these messages only to reply and to improve the app, never for advertising.

sections.h: 8. Lesson downloads, reminders and app updates
p: Lesson films, coaching voice and lesson updates are downloaded from our media server operated by Cloudflare, Inc. Like any web server, it briefly processes your IP address and basic request details to deliver the files and protect the service; we do not use these logs to identify you.
Practice reminders are scheduled locally on your phone; we use no push-notification service and no notification token.

We use information to provide the app and the subscription you bought (performance of a contract); to keep the app working, secure and improving and to understand usage (our legitimate interests in running and improving Asanova, balanced against your rights and the controls described above); to measure and improve our advertising (our legitimate interest in growing Asanova, or your consent where the law requires consent, including your App Tracking Transparency choice on iOS); and to meet legal, tax and accounting obligations.
Health information you enter is processed only on your own device, at your request, to personalise your plan; it is not processed by us.

We share information only for the purposes described: Apple and Google (payments and app distribution), the payment processor identified at checkout, payment network and your bank (enabled UPI payments), RevenueCat (store subscription status), PostHog (usage statistics), Meta (advertising measurement), Cloudflare (media delivery) and Lovable Cloud (payment records and the private feedback inbox). We may also disclose information if required by law, to protect our rights or users' safety, or as part of a merger or sale of the business under this policy's protections.

We do not sell personal information for money. Under some US state laws (such as California's), sharing device identifiers and app events with Meta for advertising measurement may be considered "sharing" or "targeted advertising"; you can opt out of it at any time with the Usage statistics switch or your device's advertising settings, or by emailing us.

Our providers may process information in the United States, the European Union, India and other countries. Where required, transfers rely on safeguards such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, and on the providers' contractual commitments.

On-device data stays until you reset it or uninstall the app. Usage statistics are kept for up to 24 months and then deleted or aggregated. Meta keeps advertising data according to its own policy. Purchase records are kept by Apple, Google and RevenueCat as required for tax and accounting. Feedback messages are kept only as long as needed to handle your request and related follow-up.

Depending on where you live (for example the EU or UK under the GDPR, India under the DPDP Act, Brazil under the LGPD, or California and other US states), you may have the right to access, correct, delete or receive a copy of your personal information, to object to or restrict its use, to withdraw consent, to opt out of targeted advertising, and to nominate someone to act for you. We will not treat you differently for using these rights.

Because Asanova has no accounts, most information is linked only to random identifiers, so we may not be able to match it to you. To make a request, email pranacodes@gmail.com. The quickest way to stop usage statistics and advertising measurement is the Usage statistics switch, and Reset all data starts a new random identifier. We answer within the time the law requires (usually 30 days). You may also complain to your local data protection authority, or in India to the Data Protection Board of India.

Information sent by the app travels over encrypted (HTTPS) connections, provider access is limited to what each service needs, and we keep no copy of your health answers anywhere. No method of storage or transmission is completely secure, so please keep your device protected with a passcode.

Asanova is made for adults. It is not directed to children under 16 (or the age of digital consent where you live), and we do not knowingly collect information from them. If you believe a child has used the app and information was shared, contact us and we will delete what we can.

Asanova is a general wellness app, not a medical device and not a healthcare provider, and nothing in it is medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Please read the Health and safety section of our Terms of use and talk to your doctor before starting, especially if you are pregnant or live with any medical condition.
If we change what is collected or shared, we will update this policy, change the date at the top and, for significant changes, tell you in the app.
Questions, requests or complaints: Mohit, Prana Codes (privacy/grievance contact) · pranacodes@gmail.com · +91 90347 05852 · Prana Codes, 164, Barauli (24), Baroli, Sonipat, Haryana 131021, India.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms apply when you download or use Asanova (Android package com.asanova.yoga, and the iPhone and iPad app). By using the app you agree to them. If you downloaded the app from the Apple App Store, Apple's Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement also applies. Please read the Health and safety section carefully before you practise.

sections.h: 1. Health and safety — please read first
p: Asanova provides general wellness and educational guidance on yoga postures, breathing and meditation. It is not a medical device, it is not provided by doctors, physiotherapists or other licensed healthcare professionals, and nothing in the app is medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. It does not replace care from a qualified professional. Do not ignore or delay professional advice because of something in the app.

Ask your doctor before starting Asanova or any new exercise, breathing or meditation practice — and in particular if you are pregnant, may be pregnant or have recently given birth; are recovering from surgery, an injury or an illness; or live with a heart or circulation condition, high or low blood pressure, glaucoma or other eye conditions, osteoporosis, a back, neck or joint problem, a hernia, diabetes, epilepsy or seizures, asthma or other breathing conditions, dizziness or balance problems, or any other medical condition.

Some practices are not right for everyone. Avoid inversions, deep twists and strong backbends unless your doctor agrees and you feel ready. Breath retention (holding the breath), fast or forceful breathing and abdominal techniques should be skipped if you are pregnant, or have high blood pressure, heart disease, epilepsy, a history of panic attacks, recent abdominal surgery or a hernia. Never practise breathing exercises in water, while driving or while operating machinery.

Meditation and deep relaxation can sometimes bring up strong emotions or memories. If you live with a mental health condition, or feel distressed during or after practice, pause and speak to a qualified professional. Asanova is not a crisis service: if you are in crisis or thinking about harming yourself, contact your local emergency number or a crisis helpline straight away.

Listen to your body. Move only within a comfortable, pain-free range, use a chair, wall, blanket or cushion whenever you need support, practise on a stable non-slip surface with enough space around you, and stop immediately if you feel pain, dizziness, faintness, chest pain or pressure, shortness of breath, numbness or unusual discomfort. If symptoms do not settle quickly, seek medical help — in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

Our cues, timings and modifications are general and cannot take your individual body, health or history into account, even when your plan is personalised from your answers. Your plan is a suggestion, not a prescription. Results differ from person to person and we make no promise of any particular outcome, such as weight loss, pain relief or the cure or prevention of any condition.
Descriptions of yogic traditions — such as chakras, energy, mantras or mudras — are shared for cultural and contemplative context. They are not medical or scientific claims.
You choose whether, when and how to practise, and you do so voluntarily and at your own risk. Children under 16 should not use the app.

Some courses, classes and meditations need Asanova Plus. Prices, billing period and any trial are shown in the app before you buy and are charged to your Apple ID or Google Play account at confirmation of purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before that. Where a free trial is offered, it converts to a paid subscription when the trial ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before. Any unused part of a trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription. Lifetime access is a one-time purchase.

You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store or Google Play account settings. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription. Refunds are handled by Apple or Google under their policies; this does not affect any rights you have under consumer law.

Availability and INR pricing: UPI is offered only where the payment service has been approved and activated; otherwise the ordinary app-store plans apply. The proposed India offer is ₹2 for the first day of Asanova Plus, then ₹399 per month, including applicable taxes. The exact offer, currency (INR), amount due today, recurring amount and billing period displayed before confirmation govern your purchase. No undisclosed price range or additional charge replaces the amount you approve.

Services and delivery: Asanova Plus provides access to the included guided yoga courses and classes, meditation and breathing practices, and eligible lesson downloads for the paid period. It is digital content; there is no physical shipping. Access is granted after the payment processor confirms successful payment, not merely when you return from a payment app. An unsuccessful payment or mandate authorisation alone does not establish paid access.

Mandate and payment flow: review the offer and recurring terms, choose a payment app, and review the processor/bank mandate approval screen showing the merchant, exact debit amount or maximum, monthly frequency, start date and validity. Approve only if you agree; your UPI PIN stays in your payment app. The first-day payment and monthly recurring mandate are separate facts verified by the processor. A one-time ₹2 payment does not by itself authorise future debits. Required pre-debit notices and retry rules are provided by your processor, bank and payment network. Monthly debits must never exceed the authorised mandate or continue after its valid revocation.

Cancellation: revoke the Asanova mandate in your UPI app's Autopay / Mandates section before the next debit to stop future charges. A paused mandate follows the bank's pause/resume rules; revoke it if you want to terminate it. For help, contact Mohit at Prana Codes using the contacts below; we acknowledge cancellation support requests within 2 working days and coordinate with the processor. You keep access until the end of the period already paid for. Deleting the app does not cancel a mandate.

Refunds: all payments are final and non-refundable. We do not offer refunds or credits for partially used periods, unused time, change of mind, or forgetting to cancel before a renewal — cancel before the next debit date to avoid the next charge. The only exception: if you paid but did not receive the service (Plus did not unlock within 48 hours of a successful debit, and we cannot restore it), email us with the UTR within 30 days and we will refund that payment to the original UPI account within 5–7 working days of verification. Nothing here limits any refund right the law gives you that cannot be waived.

Failed, pending or duplicate payments: do not repeatedly pay while an earlier payment is pending. If money is debited but access is missing, contact us with the payment reference, date and amount so we can verify and restore service or apply the non-delivery refund policy above. Bank reversals and confirmed duplicate/unauthorised charges follow the bank/processor rules and mandatory consumer rights; timing can vary and is not guaranteed by Asanova.

Restoring access: contact support with your UTR or mandate reference. We verify ownership before restoring access on a different phone; possession of a payment reference alone must not transfer another person's subscription. Never send us your UPI PIN, OTP or bank password.

We give you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable licence to use the app and its content for your own, non-commercial practice. Please do not copy, record, resell, redistribute, teach from, publicly perform or reverse-engineer the app, its films, voice recordings, images or other content, and do not use it in any unlawful way.

We keep improving courses and may add, change or retire content and features. We aim to keep the app available and accurate, but it is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, to the extent the law allows.

To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential loss, or for any injury, illness or loss arising from practising poses, breathing or meditation, particularly against the guidance in section 1. Our total liability for any claim relating to the app is limited to the amount you paid for Asanova in the 12 months before the claim. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot be excluded by law, such as for death or personal injury caused by negligence or for fraud, or limits rights you have under consumer law.
How the app handles information is explained in our Privacy policy, which forms part of these terms.

These terms are governed by the laws of India, without affecting any mandatory consumer protections of the country where you live. Before starting any formal dispute, please email us so we can try to resolve it.
We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the latest version. Continuing to use the app after an update means you accept the new terms.
